description: Scripted assistant conversation for pytest and Playwright (CLAUDE_FAKE_CHAT_FILE, never used in production). Every owner message replays it: one run_quick_analysis call with a 6000 mAh battery (20 % more capacity), then an answer that quotes the before and after numbers from the tool result together with one propose_change, then a closing sentence.

content.text: I'll check that with a quick analysis of the draft with a 6000 mAh battery.

The quick analysis gives a wing-flight endurance of {{run_quick_analysis.after.key_numbers.endurance_cruise}} with the 6000 mAh battery, against {{run_quick_analysis.before.key_numbers.endurance_cruise}} now. Take-off mass becomes {{run_quick_analysis.after.key_numbers.takeoff_mass}} (was {{run_quick_analysis.before.key_numbers.takeoff_mass}}). Keep flights within visual line of sight (EU Open category A3).

input.summary: Increase the battery capacity from 5000 mAh to 6000 mAh (quick analysis above).

content.text: Press "Try as new version" to save it as a new version and run a full analysis on it.
